name: The Thirsty Goblin
summary: In Gadgetzan, Marin Noggenfogger longs for a drink that can end his unending thirst. He has heard the dew collectors in the cactus garden southwest of town keep water in special glands, and hopes one will make such a drink possible.

sections.title: A Gland Worth Drinking
sections.body: Marin Noggenfogger has heard of dew collectors in the cactus garden southwest of Gadgetzan. They keep water in special glands, and he believes a full gland could start a drink that ends his thirst for good. He asks you to find their garden and bring one back.

faq.q: Who sends you to hunt for the dew gland?
faq.answer: Marin Noggenfogger in Gadgetzan asks you to find a full dew gland, hoping it will cure his terrible thirst.

faq.q: Where are the dew collectors located?
faq.answer: The dew collectors live in the cactus garden of Thistleshrub Valley, southwest of Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

faq.q: What creature carries the laden dew gland?
faq.answer: Thistleshrub Dew Collectors carry the glands, which are said to store water.

faq.q: What comes next in the chain?
faq.answer: The chain continues with In Good Taste.
